description: Rank capabilities for a described task by task match, measured synthetic success rate, and expected cost per accepted result, and explain the ranking. Use this to decide which capability to run before quoting it. The task may be described in English, Arabic, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Chinese, or Japanese; this is discovery only, and every deliverable is produced in English.

available_only.description: Exclude capabilities the provider cannot run right now.

task.description: The work the caller wants done, in words. Any supported language; native scripts and transliterations are both accepted.

name: select_capability

language.description: How the query was read for multilingual discovery. Present on every response; null only when multilingual matching is disabled.

declared_overlap.description: Distinctive words the request shares with this capability's own advertised text. Breaks ties on match_score so the closest fit ranks first.

supported_query_languages.description: Languages discovery accepts, with labels. Null when multilingual matching is disabled.

title: Choose the best SwishrJobs capability for a task
